blocks.text: Now it can be said. Ruffa Gutierrez disclosed that her dad veteran actor Eddie Gutierrez had faced a medical challenge, but has now been declared cancer-free by his Singapore-based doctors. Speaking to the entertainment press after the advanced screening of her new movie “Red Crown,” Ruffa said their family had decided to keep from the public the details about her father’s health status because they wanted to keep his medical condition private.
